title: Star Trek, X-Men Actor Patrick Stewart Dies at 86
content: Stewart was born in Mirfield in the West Riding of Yorkshire on July 13, 1940. Stewart had many roles, but he was perhaps best known for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and later Star Trek: Picard .

title: Naruto’s Most Exciting Battle Against Madara Is Getting a New U.S. Release
content: Naruto Shippuden is all set to release Blu-ray Set 12 this November, as confirmed by the official website of Viz Media .
